purpose: Explicit NON-LIVE gas-only candidate overlays. These are not complete service/website configurations.

configuration_layout.read_configuration: Separate complete reviewed deployment inventory; unchanged by these gas overlays
configuration_layout.activation_configuration: Complete ActivationConfig JSON supplied through --activation-config; root schema2 and activation fee_policy only
configuration_layout.claim_transaction_configuration: Separate TransactionConfig JSON supplied through --transaction-config; keep existing schema/chain/projection identity and gas policy unchanged
configuration_layout.service_listeners: Production workers require separate activation and mint/claim listeners; never merge the two configurations
configuration_layout.manual_lp_policy: Separate complete manual LP policy JSON with its own fee_policy
configuration_layout.keeper_configuration: Separate complete loaded keeper JSON; top-level max_gas_limit controls all enabled jobs

maintenance_keeper.scope: Global cap for all jobs enabled in that loaded keeper config; per-job economics and transaction/day limits remain

merge_rules: Merge only the explicit overlay fields into a separately reviewed complete matching configuration; do not pass this package to a production loader.
Never replace whole limits/fee_policy dictionaries while dropping existing financial/value or permission fields.
Backend configured20M must equal website limits.gas exactly; lower effective chain/block values remain binding.
Keep claim transaction policy unchanged and preserve all loss/oracle/NAV/route/idle/authority/callback guards.
Keeper/manual24M is distinct from website claim/activation policy.
No source-call/quote/payout/royalty-sync subcall gas setting changes.
No existing service, process, Anvil, journal, signer or public website configuration is modified.
unresolved_required_review: Actual complete network fee semantics and max_gas_price_wei
Actual provider gas/call/trace/history limits and sustained operation
Matching complete read/configuration/runtime/anchor identities and consumer hashes
Exact real market/feed/route/OpenSea/VRF and max-state execution qualification

software_verification.scope: Injected RPC/software-boundary checks only; EVM/provider campaign is separate.
